narrative.overview: A precise, quiet tool for making geometry. The reference to school mathematics comes through restrained ink colors, legible code and the actual construction grid on the drawing canvas. Familiar web controls keep the learner's attention on their program. The geometric turtle mark and the live drawings provide the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces and fine structural rules.
Polish copy that explains the next action.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Interface color describes action or state; drawings own their own colors.

rules.name: The Code Alignment Rule
rules.body: Highlight layer, textarea and line numbers must share font metrics; visual styling cannot move tokens away from editable text.

dos: Do give geometry the largest uninterrupted work area.
Do keep every syntax overlay aligned with its textarea.
Do preserve original drawing colors in every theme and export.
Do name actions and recovery steps in Polish.
donts: Don't use a decorative construction grid outside a real drawing surface.
Don't turn command reference text into a display typography treatment.
Don't replace a learner’s program without preserving a recoverable version.
